verdict.rationale: Private sub-teams with restricted membership is a fair axis for a work-management platform like monday.com, so it applies. However, the evidence pack never documents creating teams, sub-teams, or member-restricted private spaces. The only access-control mention is scoping agents' board access from the admin, which is a different feature and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create private sub-teams restricted to specific members
